audit.whatIsWrong: The entire matchup is built on "track Relentless Pursuit" / "Only commit E when his E dash is on cooldown", as if it were a fixed timer. It is the focus ability, the loading tip, the cooldowns breakdown and the all-in trigger.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit's printed 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 is a ceiling, not a real cooldown: "Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown". Since Lightslinger procs off every ability he casts, a Lucian who is actively trading refunds his dash continuously. Counting sixteen seconds and then committing is precisely how a Zac gets punished. The read has to be his auto-attacks, not a stopwatch. At rank 5 the dash is also free (0 mana), so there is no resource gate either.
audit.corrected: Stated in whys[2], spikes[0].text, wants.you[0], mid and breakdown.difficulty.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lucian.json (E "Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown", cost 32/24/16/8/0)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere notes that Lucian's passive is armed by nearby immobilised enemies.
audit.why: Lightslinger gives his next 2 basic attacks bonus magic damage "when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized". Zac's whole kit is displacement - the Q knock-together, the E landing knockup and four separate R knockups. So Zac's own engage switches on Lucian's damage steroid, and the R chain arms it repeatedly. This is the least intuitive thing in the matchup and the entry never mentions it: a Zac who chains CC perfectly is also feeding the bonus that kills him.
audit.corrected: Added to whys[4], spikes[1].text and late.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lucian.json (P "when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage")

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry is labelled HARD at difficulty 8.5/10, and the level chart gives Lucian 6 of 7 stages - but Zac wins 54.07% across 405 games.
audit.why: Two separate contradictions pointing the same way. 405 games is a large sample and 54% is a clearly favourable matchup, so an 8.5/10 "HARD" rating plus a 6/7 chart tells the player to dodge or play scared in a lane the data says they win. The laning phase genuinely is Lucian's; the rating and the chart just over-extend that into the whole game.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 6.5/10, chart Lucian / Lucian / Lucian / Lucian / Skill / Skill / Zac. Lucian's carryRating of 8.5/10 is left alone - his ability to carry is not the same claim as the lane being hard.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagree about the final stage: content win[6] says "Zac" while full phases[6].side says "Lucian".
audit.why: Same matchup, same stage, opposite answers depending on which card the player is looking at. The full layer's own phases[6].why ("your side-lane pattern is at full power") argues for Zac, so the side label is the part that is wrong.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side set to Zac, matching content and matching its own why text.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood tells Zac to "W the %HP ticks" against Lucian.
audit.why: Unstable Matter deals a percentage of the target's maximum health, and Lucian is a marksman with one of the smaller health pools Zac meets. W is his weakest tool here. This is the same templated clause that appears across Zac matchups regardless of the enemy.
audit.corrected: tradeGood rewritten around the dash window instead.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zac.json (W "a percentage of their maximum health")

audit.why: The Culling is 110/100/90 against Zac's Let's Bounce! at 120/105/90 - his ultimate is genuinely up more often at ranks 1 and 2 and level with Zac at rank 3, which supports the existing "level 6 is his" framing. No change needed.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6.5/10. Relentless Pursuit's printed cooldown is a ceiling — his Lightslinger attacks keep refunding it.

edits.before: Lucian bullies you early — his passive double-shot after any ability and his Q (Piercing Light) poke chunk your blobs faster than they regen, and you have no ranged answer. Don't walk up to trade; last-hit at max range, eat harass with your passive, and hold E.
edits.after: Lucian bullies you early — Lightslinger double-shots after any ability and Q (Piercing Light) poke chunk your blobs faster than they regen. Don't walk up to trade; last-hit at max range, eat harass with your passive, and hold E rather than spending it on a dash he mirrors.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay rough: his E (Relentless Pursuit) dash reliably sidesteps your telegraphed E (Elastic Slingshot) engage, and even at 6 his Culling burst plus the dash means a mistimed R (Let's Bounce!) whiffs and you get punished. Only engage when his dash is down, ideally with Flash to guarantee the knock-up.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay rough: Relentless Pursuit sidesteps your telegraphed E (Elastic Slingshot), and its printed 16s is only a ceiling — every Lightslinger double-shot refunds part of it, so stop counting seconds and watch his autos instead. Engage when the dash is actually spent, ideally with Flash to guarantee the knock-up.

edits.before: This is a scaling matchup that swings to you with items — as a full tank you shrug off his damage and your E-flash into R can lock him for your team before he dashes free. Group up, let him be your kill target in fights, and stop soloing him once he's fed. Your teamfight engage is worth more than any solo trade here.
edits.after: This is a scaling matchup that swings to you with items — as a full tank you shrug off his damage and your E-flash into R can lock him for your team before he dashes free. One caution: his passive arms off nearby immobilised enemies, so your own chain CC feeds his autos. Group and make him the team's kill target, not your solo one.

notes: Two coupled fixes here that must land together or the entry contradicts itself: diff/diffRating/breakdown.difficulty/report[14].t all carry the 8.5/10 HARD rating, and content win[6] already disagreed with full phases[6].side before I touched anything. carryRating stays 8.5/10 deliberately. The immobilise-arms-Lightslinger point is marked Medium confidence: the kit text says "immobilized" and I am reading Zac's knockups as satisfying that, which is standard League terminology but is not spelled out in the kit file - worth a wiki check before it ships.
